prior_crc_adenoma_methylation: Yes; CRC promoter hypermethylation and advanced-adenoma evidence.
prior_expression_function: Yes; inverse methylation-expression correlation and tumor-suppressor function.
primary_source: PMID 25620232; doi 10.1002/mc.22247; 2015; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25620232/ | PMID 29436791; no DOI in PubMed summary; 2018; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29436791/
exact_support: CRC tissues were hypermethylated, advanced adenomas also showed methylation, methylation inversely tracked expression, and the 2015 paper framed EYA4 as a CRC tumor suppressor.
current_addition_in_this_revision: Adds Korean paired PSQ plus public lesion, expression, stromal, and CMS context.
evidence_boundary: Prior evidence is real and should not be presented as locus discovery in this revision.

prior_crc_adenoma_methylation: Partial; exact quoted PubMed search found only a broader serrated-cancer methylome paper that names ZNF568 among hypermethylated loci.
prior_expression_function: No CRC-specific expression/function paper located in exact search.
exact_support: ZNF568 is listed among loci persistently hypermethylated across sessile serrated polyps and serrated cancers.
current_addition_in_this_revision: Adds Korean paired PSQ plus public lesion, expression, stromal, and CMS context.
evidence_boundary: Locus-level serrated-pathway context is not the same as a standalone ZNF568 CRC validation.

prior_crc_adenoma_methylation: Yes; ZNF793 was one of six methylation markers verified in colorectal precancerous lesions in Parker et al. 2018.
prior_expression_function: No CRC-specific expression/function paper located in exact search.
exact_support: The study compared sessile serrated adenomas/polyps, conventional adenomas, and normal mucosa and included ZNF793 in the six verified methylation markers.
current_addition_in_this_revision: Adds Korean paired PSQ plus public lesion, expression, stromal, and CMS context.
evidence_boundary: Prior gene-region methylation evidence is established. Identity between the prior marker region and the present retained CpGs has not been established by this literature correction.

prior_crc_adenoma_methylation: Yes; CRC biomarker and advanced-CRC hypermethylation evidence.
prior_expression_function: Yes; expression is higher in normal mucosa and lower in adenoma, CRC, and metastasis, with promoter methylation inversely tracking expression.
exact_support: The 2026 paper reports SFMBT2 hypermethylation with reduced expression across normal mucosa, advanced adenoma, CRC, and metastasis, plus recurrence/prognosis associations.
current_addition_in_this_revision: Adds Korean paired PSQ plus public lesion, expression, stromal, and CMS context.
evidence_boundary: Prior evidence is already close to the current claim; the new value is cross-cohort integration and paired Korean quantification.

prior_crc_adenoma_methylation: Yes; CRC promoter hypermethylation and stool-DNA screening panel evidence.
prior_expression_function: Yes; methylation is linked to reduced ADHFE1 mRNA/protein and to CRC proliferation/cell-cycle effects.
exact_support: ADHFE1 promoter hypermethylation in CRC is concordant with reduced expression, and later studies place ADHFE1 in CRC stool-DNA screening panels.
current_addition_in_this_revision: Adds Korean paired PSQ plus public lesion, expression, stromal, and CMS context.
evidence_boundary: Do not frame ADHFE1 as a new locus; the new value is cohort context and cross-tissue replication.

prior_crc_adenoma_methylation: Yes; promoter methylation in CRC with clinicopathologic correlation and early-stage enrichment.
prior_expression_function: No strong CRC-specific function paper located in this search.
exact_support: The HOXA2 promoter methylation paper reports CRC-specific promoter methylation patterns and clinicopathologic correlation, with higher methylation in earlier disease.
current_addition_in_this_revision: Adds Korean paired PSQ plus public lesion and molecular-context replication.
evidence_boundary: Keep the claim at methylation/clinicopathologic association.

current_addition_in_this_revision: Adds Korean paired PSQ plus public lesion, expression, stromal, and CMS replication.

prior_crc_adenoma_methylation: Yes; frequent CRC hypermethylation and early-event language.
prior_expression_function: Yes; methylation is negatively correlated with protein expression and the gene is treated as a tumor-suppressor candidate.
primary_source: PMID 19331160; no DOI in PubMed summary; 2009; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19331160/ | PMID 28378635; doi 10.1177/1010428317697564; 2017; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28378635/ | PMID 29801399; doi 10.22034/APJCP.2018.19.5.1185; 2018; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29801399/
exact_support: UNC5C methylation is frequently detected in CRC and adenomatous polyps, reported as an early event, and associated with reduced protein expression.
current_addition_in_this_revision: Adds Korean paired PSQ plus public lesion, expression, stromal, and CMS context.
evidence_boundary: The new revision extends established CRC methylation evidence; it does not establish a new mechanism.

prior_crc_adenoma_methylation: Yes; Ma et al. 2025 reported higher RALYL promoter methylation in COAD and READ using UALCAN.
prior_expression_function: Yes; a 2025 CRC paper reports tumor-suppressor activity via HNRNPC-mediated MNK2 alternative splicing.
exact_support: Methods section 2.12 and Figure 1A report the UALCAN promoter-methylation analysis; the study also tested RALYL function through HNRNPC-mediated MNK2 splicing.
current_addition_in_this_revision: Adds Korean paired PSQ plus public lesion, expression, stromal, and CMS context.
evidence_boundary: This is both methylation and functional prior evidence. The present assays provide additional paired Korean gene-region measurements, not a first RALYL methylation finding.

prior_crc_adenoma_methylation: Yes; Dong et al. 2020 reported higher methylation in colorectal tumor versus non-tumor tissue and lower methylation in invasive versus non-invasive tumors.
prior_expression_function: Yes; targeted demethylation increased GFRA1 expression and promoted epithelial-mesenchymal transition and invasive behavior.
primary_source: PMID 33175846; doi 10.1371/journal.pgen.1009159; 2020; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33175846/ | PMID 31988584; doi 10.3748/wjg.v26.i2.184; 2020; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31988584/
exact_support: Dong2020 Results and Figures 1-2 distinguish the tissue and invasion contrasts. Its supplementary Figure S3 includes cg06298519, cg19485539, and cg19236679, which are also retained here.
current_addition_in_this_revision: Adds Korean paired PSQ plus public lesion, expression, stromal, and CMS context.
evidence_boundary: The tissue contrasts are compatible. Three overlapping retained array sites preclude attributing the literature contrast solely to different probes. The current PSQ-array mapping is reference-inferred and does not establish laboratory-verified assay identity.
